title: Wayfinder Router: deterministic routing of queries between local and hosted LLM
summary: Wayfinder Router is an open-source tool that provides deterministic routing for queries between local (self-hosted) and hosted LLM endpoints, enabling developers to intelligently route AI requests based on predefined rules or conditions.
problem_solved: Enables cost-effective and flexible LLM usage by automatically routing queries to either local or hosted models based on deterministic rules.
why_valuable: It provides developers with fine-grained control over LLM infrastructure, potentially reducing costs by using local models for simpler tasks while reserving hosted models for complex requests.
